clips.send: Someone sends it to a friend who still trusts anything with an FDA stamp on the box - anger at being lied to.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau walks through how a drug actually gets approved: companies spend hundreds of millions on research and clinical trials, then send it all to the FDA.

His example: the FDA studied the research and said the drug Vioxx was safe and effective. It got approved. A few years later, 200,000 people who took it had died.

Further study found Vioxx wasn't safe, and it didn't reduce pain any better than a normal Tylenol.

Kevin Trudeau's question: did the FDA lie, or were they just wrong?

#kevintrudeau #fda #healthtruth #askquestions #wbdaily #consumerhealth

clips.send: A parent sends it to anyone who's ever been told sugar doesn't touch their kid's energy - the vindication of knowing you were right.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau reads a USA Today headline: a study proves sugar has no effect on a child's hyperactivity.

His gut reaction: everyone already knows that's wrong. His own test of it - a rainy, gloomy drive to Krispy Kreme with three friends, dead silent the whole way. Two dozen donuts later, they're singing and dancing in the car.

Then he found the actual study: eight kids, given ten candy bars, monitored. Then given two more candy bars. Their activity level barely changed.

His takeaway: they were already so jacked up on sugar, it couldn't get any higher.

#kevintrudeau #sugar #foodtruth #healthtruth #wbdaily #askquestions
